title: Trace requirements through UX, UI, and technical design
statement: As a designer, architect, or reviewer, I can see exactly which UX flows, UI references, and technical diagrams address each accepted story or acceptance criterion.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A current typed relation can link a UX deck, UI reference or embed, technical-design target, diagram, Slide, or Item to a story or criterion in the same Saga.
Each design link pins the target story revision and the current canonical source-content digest so edits become stale instead of silently remaining current.
A Deck, Slide, group, or diagram reaches descendant Item evidence only when its relation explicitly declares descendant scope; leaf links remain self-scoped.
Each accepted criterion reports direct, broad, excluded, gap, stale, invalid, or conflicted design coverage with concrete relations and diagnostics.
Story-level links remain visibly broad and criterion-level links visibly direct; full coverage and full criterion precision are reported separately.
The design view exposes targets, paths, exclusions, and stale reasons rather than reducing coverage to an opaque percentage.
Design > UX contains one or more slide-deck flows whose Slides and Items remain independently addressable.
Design > UI contains current external links or safe embeds such as Figma, with stable identity, revision pins, and fallback links.
Design > Technical contains focused ERD, system, and data-flow diagrams using the visual form that matches the relationship being explained.
